<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Trang-1" id="XUfIqhYUEZ9WJ-TEm6Cy"> <mxGraphModel dx="2182" dy="739" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "
@startuml
left to right direction
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam shadowing false

actor \"Khách hàng\" as Customer
actor \"Dịch vụ thanh toán\nmô phỏng\" as Payment

rectangle \"Hệ thống BrewLite\" {
 usecase \"Đặt và thanh toán\nđơn hàng (UC-04)\" as UC04
 usecase \"Xác thực khách hàng\" as UC01
 usecase \"Kiểm tra giỏ hàng\" as UC02
 usecase \"Kiểm tra sản phẩm\nvà số lượng\" as UC03
 usecase \"Tính tổng tiền\" as UC05
 usecase \"Lưu đơn hàng\n(PENDING)\" as UC06
 usecase \"Xử lý thanh toán\" as UC07
 usecase \"Ghi nhận kết quả\nthanh toán\" as UC08
 usecase \"Thông báo kết quả\" as UC09

 UC04 ..> UC01 : <<include>>
 UC04 ..> UC02 : <<include>>
 UC04 ..> UC03 : <<include>>
 UC04 ..> UC05 : <<include>>
 UC04 ..> UC06 : <<include>>
 UC04 ..> UC07 : <<include>>
 UC04 ..> UC08 : <<include>>
 UC04 ..> UC09 : <<include>>
}

Customer -- UC04
Payment -- UC07
@enduml
",
